title: Page tool
description: Agents change this page live: a path and a delta, one line appended to its page.jsonl.

add.title: What this page is
add.text: Every line below was written by the page tool, not by hand. An agent sends a path and a delta; the page redraws with no reload.

add.title: How to use it
add.text: page_set(path, delta). The path is the url you see; leave it out to mean your own session page. The delta is plain JSON: the tool adds the time, your name and any missing ids.

add.title: Add a tab
add.text: {"tab": {"name": "now", "title": "Now", "content": "…"}} — the Notes tab above was made this way. A page with no tabs gets a tab strip, and its own content becomes the first tab.

add.title: Change the layout
add.text: {"navigation": "rail"} or any of the six page words: navigation, width, arrangement, surface, background, type_size. The page redraws in place.

add.title: Add to a tab
add.text: {"notes": {"content": {"add": {"title": "…"}}}} — the nesting is the path: the notes tab, its content list, add.
